title: matrix
description: Values to run this context once per combination of. Each key names a list of values. Reference a value in the context's fields or in the test's steps as `$$matrix.<key>`, or `$$matrix.<key>.<field>` for a field of an object value. The context runs once per combination of the keys it references, and each combination's context ID ends in `~<key>=<value>`. A reference that is the whole string keeps the value's type; one inside a longer string is spliced in as text. A key that the test doesn't reference doesn't multiply its contexts, but on a `runOn` the test sets itself, an unreferenced key is an error.

additionalProperties.description: The values for this key: a non-empty list of unique items, either all scalars (string, number, or boolean) or all objects whose values are scalars. Or `{ "file": "<path>" }` to read the list from a file.

file.description: Path of a `.json` file that holds the list, or of an `.xml` sitemap whose `<loc>` entries are the values. A relative path resolves against the file that declares this `runOn`, or the working directory with `relativePathBase: "cwd"`. Doc Detective reads it before any test runs.

reference.description: A `$$matrix.<key>` or `$$matrix.<key>.<field>` reference, replaced by the context's matrix value.
